I'm sure somebody wants the chair.|Syril Karn and the officr|}} A [[human]] '''officer''' lived during the [[Imperial Era]] and worked for [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] as an [[Astro-Traffic Control Officer]]. In [[5 BBY]], when [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] was investigating the murder of two security officers by an unidentified [[Kenari]] human [[Gender|male]], the control officer was tasked with discovering where the fugitive's ship went after it left [[Morlana One]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The officer first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' television series episode "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]."
